label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — fictional prices and securities
limitations: Synthetic timestamps do not reconstruct the historical information set.
No costs, taxes, liquidity or FX simulation; supplied current weights are hypothetical historical holdings.
Small evaluation samples and small expected exception counts weaken asymptotic coverage inference.
A high Kupiec p-value is not proof of reliability or exception independence.

provenance.source: RiskLens deterministic generator v0.1.0; NumPy PCG64 seed 1729
provenance.adjustment_basis: Synthetic split/dividend-adjusted levels; no real corporate actions or market prices.
provenance.calendar_assumption: 756 synthetic weekday sessions; real exchange holidays deliberately not modeled.

configuration.exception_rule: realized_loss > var; ties are not exceptions
